authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-7-alpha targeting tenant-7-bravo/order-7.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-7-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-7-bravo/order-7. The gateway records status 200, state_changed=true, and is_admin=false [log-1]. The policy permits cross-tenant writes only for administrators [policy-1]. Conclusion: An unauthorized cross-tenant write was achieved with verified state change. These records do not establish data exfiltration.
